notes.title: Red Tie Runner source code available
notes.notes:
Hi all! I've released the source code for RTR and made the repository open source. If you are interested in learning about 2D game development, Construct 3, or Github, this could be a great resource. If you'd like to take a shot at fixing bugs, refactoring, or adding content please fork the repo, build a branch, and submit a pull request. Also feel free to report bugs / issues on the git repo. Thanks and happy developing! 

[url=https://github.com/ReflextionsDev/RTR]https://github.com/ReflextionsDev/RTR[/url]
